## Structural Equation Modeling

Fit a Bayesian SEM to understand causal pathways among ecosystem components.

```{r sem-prep}
#| label: sem-preparation

# Calculate year residuals (disturbances beyond temperature)
yearresid <- resid(lm(Year ~ Max_temp, data = Year_Averages, na.action = na.pass))

# Prepare scaled SEM data
semdata2 <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy = log(mean_fleshy),
    logrd = log(Rd),
    logpmax = log(Pmax),
    logproducers = log(mean_alive),
    N_percent = log(N_percent),
    yearresid = yearresid
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, logproducers, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp, flow = Flow_mean, Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral, logfleshy, Corallivore,
    herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
```

```{r sem-fit}
#| label: sem-model
#| cache: true

# Define SEM structure
bf_temp <- bf(temperature | mi() ~ 1 + Year)
bf_coraltemp <- bf(logcoral | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ 1 + temperature + yearresid)
bf_logpmax <- bf(logpmax | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature) + mi(logrd)) ####
bf_logrd <- bf(logrd | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature))
bf_herbs <- bf(herbs | mi() ~ 1 + logfleshy)
bf_corallivore <- bf(Corallivore | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_fleshy <- bf(logfleshy | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ logcoral)
bf_nutrients <- bf(Npercent | mi() ~ 1 + mi(logrd))

# Fit full SEM
brms_sem_full <- brm(
  bf_temp + bf_coraltemp + bf_logrd + bf_herbs + bf_corallivore +
    bf_nutrients + bf_fleshy + bf_logpmax + set_rescor(FALSE),
  data = semdata2,
  chains = 3,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  seed = 11,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior = c(
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", resp = "temperature", class = "sigma", lb = 0),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept")
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  family = gaussian(),
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r sem-summary}
#| label: sem-results

summary(brms_sem_full)
```

```{r}
#| label: sem-r2-calculation

# Calculate Bayesian R² for each response variable in the SEM
# Note: Some responses with missing data imputation may have NaN - filter these out
sem_r2 <- bayes_R2(brms_sem_full, summary = FALSE)
sem_r2_summary <- apply(sem_r2, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Remove NaN values
sem_r2_valid <- sem_r2_summary[!is.na(sem_r2_summary)]

cat("\n=== Structural Equation Model: Bayesian R² by Response ===\n\n")
sem_r2_df <- tibble(
  Response = names(sem_r2_valid),
  R2 = sem_r2_valid
) |>
  mutate(Response = case_when(
    Response == "R2temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    Response == "R2logcoral" ~ "Coral Cover",
    Response == "R2logpmax" ~ "Ecosystem Pmax",
    Response == "R2logrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd",
    Response == "R2herbs" ~ "Herbivorous Fish",
    Response == "R2Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore Fish",
    Response == "R2logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae",
    Response == "R2Npercent" ~ "N Content",
    TRUE ~ Response
  )) |>
  arrange(desc(R2))

print(sem_r2_df, n = Inf)

cat("\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean R² across computable responses: %.3f\n", mean(sem_r2_valid)))
cat(sprintf("The SEM explains between %.1f%% and %.1f%% of variance across responses.\n",
            min(sem_r2_valid) * 100, max(sem_r2_valid) * 100))
cat("Note: R² not computed for responses with extensive missing data imputation.\n")
```

## SEM Conceptual Model

```{r sem-dag}
#| label: fig-sem-dag
#| fig-cap: "**Bayesian structural equation model reveals coral cover as the central mediator of climate-driven ecosystem change.** Directed acyclic graph shows the 11 hypothesised causal pathways among nine ecosystem components, fit simultaneously in a multivariate Bayesian SEM (n = 15 annual observations, 2008–2025). Arrow width is proportional to the absolute standardised path coefficient (|β|); blue = positive effect, red = negative effect; grey = 95% posterior credible interval crosses zero (inconclusive pathway). Standardised β values are shown on each arrow. Shaded background regions distinguish ecosystem function variables (top; Ecosystem Respiration and Ecosystem Pmax in a horizontal row, with Algal N Stock elevated above) from community composition variables (bottom; Fleshy Algae, Herbivore Fish, Corallivore Fish). All continuous variables were log-transformed where appropriate and z-score standardised (mean = 0, SD = 1) prior to analysis to permit direct comparison of effect magnitudes."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.2

pos_col  <- "#1565C0"
neg_col  <- "#B71C1C"
nsig_col <- "#AAAAAA"

# N Stock elevated above the Rd–Pmax horizontal line (y=5.0 vs Rd/Pmax at y=4.0)
# Rd→Pmax is a straight horizontal beneath N; Rd→N is a short diagonal upward
# All edges are straight segments — no curves at all
# Rows compressed: ecosystem at y=4.0, community at y=2.0, gap = 2.0 units
dag_nodes <- tribble(
  ~id,           ~label,                    ~x,    ~y,    ~fill,       ~border,
  "Year",        "Year",                    0.4,   3.5,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Temp",        "Temperature",             2.0,   3.0,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Coral",       "Coral\nCover",            3.8,   3.0,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  # Ecosystem function: Rd and Pmax in horizontal row; N elevated above
  "Rd",          "Ecosystem\nRespiration",  5.6,   4.0,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  "N",           "N\nStock",               7.4,   5.0,   "#FFF8E1",   "#E65100",
  "Pmax",        "Ecosystem\nPmax",         9.2,   4.0,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  # Community composition row
  "Algae",       "Fleshy\nAlgae",           5.6,   2.0,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  "Herbs",       "Herbivore\nFish",         7.4,   2.0,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1",
  "Corallivore", "Corallivore\nFish",       9.2,   2.0,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1"
)

dag_edges <- tribble(
  ~from,   ~to,           ~est,   ~sig,  ~loff_x, ~loff_y,
  "Year",  "Temp",        0.465,  TRUE,   0.28,    0.18,
  "Temp",  "Coral",      -0.549,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24,
  "Temp",  "Rd",          0.214,  FALSE, -0.35,    0.24,
  "Temp",  "Pmax",       -0.158,  FALSE, -0.75,   -0.22,
  "Coral", "Rd",          1.080,  TRUE,  -0.08,    0.24,
  "Coral", "Algae",      -0.914,  TRUE,  -0.08,   -0.24,
  "Coral", "Corallivore", 0.645,  TRUE,   0.38,   -0.20,
  "Coral", "Pmax",       -0.353,  FALSE,  0.38,    0.20,
  "Rd",    "N",           0.623,  TRUE,  -0.18,    0.22,   # short diagonal up-right
  "Rd",    "Pmax",        0.819,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24,   # straight horizontal below N
  "Algae", "Herbs",       0.711,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24    # straight horizontal
) |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(est >= 0, "pos", "neg"), abs_est = abs(est)) |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(from = id, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(to   = id, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") |>
  mutate(mx = (x0 + x1) / 2, my = (y0 + y1) / 2, lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est))

# All edges are straight — no geom_curve needed
dag_arr <- arrow(length = unit(3.0, "mm"), type = "closed")

ggplot() +
  # Faint region backgrounds
  annotate("rect", xmin = 4.8, xmax = 10.0, ymin = 3.2, ymax = 5.65,
           fill = "#EDE7F6", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 4.8, xmax = 10.0, ymin = 1.2, ymax = 2.75,
           fill = "#E3F2FD", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  # Region labels
  annotate("text", x = 10.12, y = 4.5, label = "Ecosystem\nfunction",
           hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "#6A1B9A", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 10.12, y = 2.0, label = "Community\ncomposition",
           hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "#1565C0", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  # Significant edges
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_edges,  sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, color = direction, linewidth = abs_est),
    alpha = 0.82, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  # Non-significant edges — reduced alpha to de-emphasise
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_edges, !sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est),
    color = nsig_col, alpha = 0.45, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_edges,  sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl, color = direction),
    size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.07, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_edges, !sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl),
    color = nsig_col, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.07, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Node boxes
  {lapply(seq_len(nrow(dag_nodes)), function(i) {
    nd <- dag_nodes[i, ]
    geom_label(data = nd, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
               fill = nd$fill, color = nd$border, size = 3.0,
               fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, label.size = 0.65,
               label.padding = unit(0.38, "lines"), label.r = unit(4, "pt"),
               show.legend = FALSE)
  })} +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pos" = pos_col, "neg" = neg_col),
                     labels = c("pos" = "Positive", "neg" = "Negative"),
                     name = "Effect direction") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.6, 2.8), guide = "none") +
  labs(caption = "Standardized β on arrows  ·  gray = 95% CI crosses zero") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.caption    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey55", size = 9, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(8, 10, 6, 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 11.8), ylim = c(1.35, 5.75))
```

## SEM Path Coefficients

```{r sem-paths}
#| label: fig-sem-paths
#| fig-cap: "Standardized effect sizes from structural equation model"
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 6

# Extract and format path coefficients
gp_edges <- as_tibble(fixef(brms_sem_full)) |>
  mutate(coef = rownames(fixef(brms_sem_full))) |>
  separate(col = coef, into = c("resp", "pred")) |>
  filter(pred != "Intercept") |>
  rename(est = Estimate, lo = `Q2.5`, hi = `Q97.5`) |>
  mutate(sig = if_else(sign(lo) == sign(hi), 1, 0.5)) |>
  mutate(resp = case_when(
    resp == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    resp == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae",
    resp == "logpmax" ~ "Ecosystem Pmax",
    resp == "logrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd",
    resp == "herbs" ~ "Herbivorous Fish",
    resp == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore Fish",
    resp == "logcoral" ~ "Coral",
    resp == "Npercent" ~ "N stock"
  )) |>
  mutate(resp = factor(resp, c(
    "Temperature", "Coral", "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Herbivorous Fish",
    "Corallivore Fish", "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Pmax", "N stock"
  ))) |>
  mutate(pred = case_when(
    pred == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "mitemperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "logproducers" ~ "Total Producer Cover",
    pred == "milogrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd Rate",
    pred == "logcoral" ~ "Coral Cover",
    pred == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover",
    pred == "Year" ~ "Year",
    pred == "yearresid" ~ "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability"
  )) |>
  mutate(pred = factor(pred, c(
    "Ecosystem Rd Rate", "Total Producer Cover",
    "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover", "Coral Cover", "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability",
    "Temperature", "Year"
  )))

gp_edges |>
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "firebrick", aes(alpha = sig)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, alpha = sig), height = 0, color = "firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.25, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "Predictor Variables",
    title = "SEM Path Coefficients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~resp, nrow = 1) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Temperature Effects: Direct vs Indirect

Calculate the total, direct, and indirect effects of temperature on all ecosystem responses.

```{r temp-effects}
#| label: fig-temp-effects
#| fig-cap: "**Temperature effects on reef ecosystem variables are dominated by indirect pathways mediated through coral decline.** Direct, indirect (coral-mediated), and total standardised temperature effects on six ecosystem variables, estimated by decomposing posterior samples from the Bayesian SEM (15,000 post-warmup draws). Points show posterior medians; horizontal error bars show 95% credible intervals. Filled symbols indicate effects whose credible intervals exclude zero; open symbols are inconclusive. Indirect effects were computed as the product of β(Temperature→Coral) × β(Coral→Response) for each posterior draw; total effects are the sum of direct and indirect components. Variables are grouped by ecosystem domain (community composition vs. ecosystem function). Note the consistent pattern of credible indirect effects alongside inconclusive direct effects, indicating that temperature acts on reef function primarily via structural coral loss rather than direct physiological warming."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| cache: true

# Extract posterior samples for path coefficients
post_samples <- as_tibble(as.matrix(brms_sem_full))

# Calculate indirect effects of temperature through coral cover
# Temperature -> Coral -> [Response]

# Direct effects (already in the model)
# Temperature -> Coral
temp_to_coral <- post_samples$b_logcoral_temperature

# Temperature -> Pmax
temp_to_pmax <- post_samples$bsp_logpmax_mitemperature

# Temperature -> Rd
temp_to_rd <- post_samples$bsp_logrd_mitemperature

# Indirect effects through coral
# Coral -> Pmax
coral_to_pmax <- post_samples$b_logpmax_logcoral

# Coral -> Rd
coral_to_rd <- post_samples$b_logrd_logcoral

# Coral -> Fleshy Algae
coral_to_fleshy <- post_samples$b_logfleshy_logcoral

# Coral -> Corallivores
coral_to_corallivore <- post_samples$b_Corallivore_logcoral

# Fleshy Algae -> Herbivores
fleshy_to_herbs <- post_samples$b_herbs_logfleshy

# Rd -> N content
rd_to_n <- post_samples$bsp_Npercent_milogrd

# Calculate total and indirect effects
effects_data <- tibble(
  # Coral (direct only)
  response = c("Coral Cover", "Coral Cover",
               # Pmax (direct + indirect through coral)
               "Ecosystem Pmax", "Ecosystem Pmax",
               # Rd (direct + indirect through coral)
               "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Rd",
               # Fleshy Algae (indirect through coral)
               "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Fleshy Macroalgae",
               # Corallivores (indirect through coral)
               "Corallivore Fish", "Corallivore Fish",
               # Herbivores (indirect through coral -> algae)
               "Herbivore Fish", "Herbivore Fish",
               # N content (indirect through coral -> Rd)
               "N Content", "N Content"),
  
  effect_type = rep(c("Direct", "Indirect"), 7),
  
  samples = list(
    # Coral
    temp_to_coral,  # Direct
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No indirect (coral is first response)
    
    # Pmax
    temp_to_pmax,  # Direct
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_pmax,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Pmax
    
    # Rd
    temp_to_rd,  # Direct
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_rd,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Rd
    
    # Fleshy Algae
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_fleshy,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Algae
    
    # Corallivores
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_corallivore,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Corallivore
    
    # Herbivores
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_fleshy * fleshy_to_herbs,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Algae -> Herbs
    
    # N content
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_rd * rd_to_n  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Rd -> N
  )
)

# Calculate summary statistics for each effect
effects_summary <- effects_data |>
  mutate(
    median = map_dbl(samples, median),
    lower = map_dbl(samples, ~quantile(.x, 0.025)),
    upper = map_dbl(samples, ~quantile(.x, 0.975)),
    significant = map_lgl(samples, ~sign(quantile(.x, 0.025)) == sign(quantile(.x, 0.975)))
  ) |>
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c(
    "Coral Cover", "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Herbivore Fish",
    "Corallivore Fish", "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Pmax", "N Content"
  )))

# Calculate total effects
total_effects <- effects_summary |>
  select(response, effect_type, samples) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = effect_type, values_from = samples) |>
  mutate(Total = map2(Direct, Indirect, ~.x + .y)) |>
  select(response, Total) |>
  mutate(
    effect_type = "Total",
    median = map_dbl(Total, median),
    lower = map_dbl(Total, ~quantile(.x, 0.025)),
    upper = map_dbl(Total, ~quantile(.x, 0.975)),
    significant = map_lgl(Total, ~sign(quantile(.x, 0.025)) == sign(quantile(.x, 0.975)))
  ) |>
  rename(samples = Total)

# Combine all effects
all_effects <- bind_rows(effects_summary, total_effects) |>
  mutate(effect_type = factor(effect_type, levels = c("Direct", "Indirect", "Total")))

# Create publication-quality plot
all_effects |>
  filter(effect_type != "Total") |>  # Show only direct and indirect for clarity
  ggplot(aes(x = median, y = response, color = effect_type, shape = effect_type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper, alpha = significant),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 0.8,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Direct" = "#E64B35", "Indirect" = "#4DBBD5"),
    name = "Effect Type"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Direct" = 16, "Indirect" = 17),
    name = "Effect Type"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.4),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "",
    title = "Temperature Effects on Ecosystem Components",
    subtitle = "Direct effects and indirect effects mediated through coral decline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40")
  )

# Print summary table
cat("\n=== Temperature Effects Summary ===\n\n")
all_effects |>
  select(response, effect_type, median, lower, upper, significant) |>
  mutate(across(median:upper, ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  arrange(response, effect_type) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r temp-indirect-ranking}
#| label: fig-temp-indirect
#| fig-cap: "Ranking of indirect temperature effects on ecosystem components"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# Extract only indirect effects and rank them
indirect_effects <- all_effects |>
  filter(effect_type == "Indirect") |>
  # Remove coral (no indirect effect)
  filter(response != "Coral Cover") |>
  arrange(median) |>
  mutate(
    response = fct_reorder(response, median),
    direction = if_else(median < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
  )

# Create ranked bar plot
indirect_effects |>
  ggplot(aes(x = response, y = median, fill = direction, alpha = significant)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.1,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "gray20",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Negative" = "#E64B35", "Positive" = "#4DBBD5"),
    name = "Effect Direction"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.2),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Standardized Indirect Effect Size",
    title = "Indirect Effects of Temperature via Coral Decline",
  #  subtitle = "Ranked from negative to positive effects with 95% credible intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 10)),
   # legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, color = "gray40")
  )

# Print ranked summary
cat("\n=== Ranked Indirect Effects (negative to positive) ===\n\n")
indirect_effects |>
  select(response, median, lower, upper, significant) |>
  mutate(across(median:upper, ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  arrange(median) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

## SEM Conditional Effects

```{r sem-conditional}
#| label: fig-sem-conditional
#| fig-cap: "**Conditional effect plots for the eight significant causal relationships in the Bayesian SEM.** Each panel shows the marginal posterior-predicted relationship for a predictor–response pair, with all other model predictors held at their posterior means. Lines show posterior means; shaded ribbons show 95% credible intervals. Coloured points are annual observed values (back-transformed from z-score scale to original units). Panels are arranged in causal order from climate forcing through coral-mediated change to ecosystem function: (A) Year → Temperature, (B) Temperature → Coral Cover, (C) Coral Cover → Fleshy Algae, (D) Coral Cover → Ecosystem Respiration, (E) Coral Cover → Corallivore Fish, (F) Fleshy Algae → Herbivore Fish, (G) Ecosystem Respiration → Algal N Content, (H) Ecosystem Respiration → Ecosystem Pmax. Conditional effects were computed using the conditional_effects() function in **brms** and back-transformed to measurement units using study-wide z-score parameters."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16

# Unscaling parameters
Yearmodelvalues <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy    = log(mean_fleshy),
    logproducers = log(mean_alive),
    logrd        = log(Rd),
    logpmax      = log(Pmax),
    N_percent    = log(N_percent),
    yearresid    = yearresid
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp, flow = Flow_mean, Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral, logproducers,
    logfleshy, Corallivore, herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral)

modelmean <- Yearmodelvalues |> summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
modelsd   <- Yearmodelvalues |> summarise(across(everything(), sd,   na.rm = TRUE))

# ── Row 1: Climate drivers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Year → Temperature
temp_year <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "temperature", effects = "Year")
ty_plot <- as_tibble(temp_year$temperature.temperature_Year) |>
  mutate(
    Year       = Year       * modelsd$Year        + modelmean$Year,
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    lower__    = lower__    * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    upper__    = upper__    * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Year, y = Max_temp), alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Temperature (°C)", title = "Year → Temperature")

# Temperature → Coral Cover
coral_temp <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logcoral", effects = "temperature")
ct_plot <- as_tibble(coral_temp$logcoral.logcoral_temperature) |>
  mutate(
    temperature = temperature * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    estimate__  = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    lower__     = exp(lower__    * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    upper__     = exp(upper__    * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = temperature, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Max_temp, y = exp(log_coral)), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(y = "log") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Coral Cover (%)", title = "Temperature → Coral Cover")

# ── Row 2: Coral → benthos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Coral Cover → Fleshy Algae
fleshy_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logfleshy", effects = "logcoral")
fc_plot <- as_tibble(fleshy_coral$logfleshy.logfleshy_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral   = exp(logcoral   * modelsd$logcoral   + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logfleshy  + modelmean$logfleshy),
    lower__    = exp(lower__    * modelsd$logfleshy  + modelmean$logfleshy),
    upper__    = exp(upper__    * modelsd$logfleshy  + modelmean$logfleshy)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = mean_fleshy), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(x = "Coral Cover (%)", y = "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover (%)",
       title = "Coral Cover → Fleshy Algae")

# Coral Cover → Ecosystem Respiration
rd_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logrd", effects = "logcoral")
rc_plot <- as_tibble(rd_coral$logrd.logrd_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral   = exp(logcoral   * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logrd    + modelmean$logrd),
    lower__    = exp(lower__    * modelsd$logrd    + modelmean$logrd),
    upper__    = exp(upper__    * modelsd$logrd    + modelmean$logrd)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = Rd), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Coral Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Ecosystem Respiration", "(mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")")),
    title = "Coral Cover → Respiration"
  )

# ── Row 3: Coral → fish ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Coral Cover → Corallivore Fish
corallivore_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "Corallivore", effects = "logcoral")
cc_plot <- as_tibble(corallivore_coral$Corallivore.Corallivore_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral   = exp(logcoral * modelsd$logcoral   + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$Corallivore  + modelmean$Corallivore,
    lower__    = lower__    * modelsd$Corallivore  + modelmean$Corallivore,
    upper__    = upper__    * modelsd$Corallivore  + modelmean$Corallivore
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = Corallivore), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Coral Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Corallivore Fish Biomass", "(g m"^-2*")")),
    title = "Coral Cover → Corallivore Fish"
  )

# Fleshy Algae → Herbivore Fish
herbs_fleshy <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "herbs", effects = "logfleshy")
hf_plot <- as_tibble(herbs_fleshy$herbs.herbs_logfleshy) |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy  = exp(logfleshy  * modelsd$logfleshy + modelmean$logfleshy),
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$herbs         + modelmean$herbs,
    lower__    = lower__    * modelsd$herbs         + modelmean$herbs,
    upper__    = upper__    * modelsd$herbs         + modelmean$herbs
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logfleshy, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = mean_fleshy, y = Herbivores), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Herbivore Fish Biomass", "(g m"^-2*")")),
    title = "Fleshy Algae → Herbivore Fish"
  )

# ── Row 4: Metabolism → ecosystem function ────────────────────────────────

# Respiration → N Content
N_Rd <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "Npercent", effects = "logrd")
nr_plot <- as_tibble(N_Rd$Npercent.Npercent_logrd) |>
  mutate(
    logrd      = exp(logrd      * modelsd$logrd    + modelmean$logrd),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent),
    lower__    = exp(lower__    * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent),
    upper__    = exp(upper__    * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logrd, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Rd, y = N_percent), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = expression("Ecosystem Respiration (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")"),
    y = "Nitrogen Content (%)",
    title = "Respiration → Algal N Content"
  )

# Respiration → Ecosystem Pmax
rd_pmax <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logpmax", effects = "logrd")
rp_plot <- as_tibble(rd_pmax$logpmax.logpmax_logrd) |>
  mutate(
    logrd      = exp(logrd      * modelsd$logrd   + modelmean$logrd),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logpmax + modelmean$logpmax),
    lower__    = exp(lower__    * modelsd$logpmax + modelmean$logpmax),
    upper__    = exp(upper__    * modelsd$logpmax + modelmean$logpmax)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logrd, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Rd, y = Pmax), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = expression("Ecosystem Respiration (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")"),
    y = expression(atop("Ecosystem Pmax", "(mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")")),
    title = "Respiration → Ecosystem Pmax"
  )

# ── Assemble 4 × 2 grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
(ty_plot | ct_plot) /
  (fc_plot | rc_plot) /
  (cc_plot | hf_plot) /
  (nr_plot | rp_plot) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```

## Ecosystem Projections

```{r cover-ceilings}
# z-log scale ceilings corresponding to 100% benthic cover.
# Both cover equations were fitted with trunc(ub = z_ceil) to respect the
# 0–100% biological bound. The same ceiling is applied in all projection
# matrices so that manual propagation is consistent with the SEM likelihood.
# Values are hardcoded (verified: back-transform to exactly 100% cover).
z_ceil_coral  <- 3.39   # (log(100) - mean(log(coral%))) / sd(log(coral%))
z_ceil_fleshy <- 2.26   # (log(100) - mean(log(fleshy%))) / sd(log(fleshy%))
```

### Linear-Trend Projections to 2055

See *Methods: Ecosystem Projections* for full specification. Projections are summarised as posterior median with 50% and 95% credible intervals; observed 2005–2025 values are shown for comparison; the forecast period (2026–2055) is shaded grey.

```{r predictions}
#| label: fig-predictions
#| fig-cap: "**Bayesian SEM projections of reef ecosystem state at MCR LTER Site 1 backreef to 2055.** Projections are derived by propagating 3,000 posterior draws through the full causal chain of the fitted SEM. Lines show posterior median trajectories; inner ribbons show 50% credible intervals; outer ribbons show 95% credible intervals. Open diamonds are annual observed values. The dashed vertical line marks 2025 (end of the observational record); the grey-shaded region is the forecast period. Panels show (A) maximum annual sea surface temperature (°C), (B) coral cover (%), (C) ecosystem dark respiration Rd (mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹), (D) fleshy macroalgae cover (%), (E) ecosystem maximum photosynthetic capacity Pmax (mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹), (F) algal tissue N content (%), and (G) ecosystem P:R ratio (Pmax / Rd). Uncertainty widens with projection distance, particularly for fleshy macroalgae and P:R ratio, reflecting compounding uncertainty propagated through multiple causal links. Projections assume continuation of current linear warming trends and do not incorporate non-linear threshold dynamics."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11

# ── Projection years (standardised to SEM scale) ─────────────────────────────
proj_years <- 2005:2055
year_std   <- (proj_years - modelmean$Year) / modelsd$Year

# 3 000 thinned posterior draws
set.seed(7341)
post <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_full) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  slice_sample(n = 3000)

n <- nrow(post)
p <- length(proj_years)

# Helper: multiply each row of an (n × p) matrix by a length-n coefficient vector
rs <- function(coef, mat) sweep(mat, 1, coef, "*")
yr_mat <- matrix(rep(year_std, each = n), nrow = n)  # n × p

# ── Propagate causal chain through the full SEM ───────────────────────────────
# 1. Temperature (z-scored)
temp_mat <- rs(post$b_temperature_Year, yr_mat) + post$b_temperature_Intercept

# ── yearresid matrix: observed z-scaled values for hindcast (2005–2025),
#    0 (standardised mean) for forecast years (2026–2055). yearresid captures
#    year-specific temperature anomalies beyond the linear trend; setting it to 0
#    for forecast years assumes future deviations are unknown and average out.
obs_yr_actual   <- round(semdata2$Year * modelsd$Year + modelmean$Year)
yr_resid_lookup <- tibble(Year = obs_yr_actual, yr = semdata2$yearresid)
yr_resid_vec    <- sapply(proj_years, function(y) {
  row <- yr_resid_lookup |> filter(Year == y)
  if (nrow(row) == 1 && !is.na(row$yr)) row$yr else 0
})
yr_resid_mat <- matrix(rep(yr_resid_vec, each = n), nrow = n)

# 2. Coral cover (log-standardised; temperature + yearresid predictors)
coral_mat <- rs(post$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat)    +
             rs(post$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat) +
             post$b_logcoral_Intercept

# 3. Ecosystem respiration (coral + direct temp via bsp for mi() imputed predictor)
rd_mat <- rs(post$b_logrd_logcoral,          coral_mat) +
          rs(post$bsp_logrd_mitemperature,   temp_mat)  +
          post$b_logrd_Intercept

# 4. Fleshy macroalgae (log-standardised; coral predictor)
fleshy_mat <- pmin(rs(post$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat) + post$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                   z_ceil_fleshy)

# 5. Corallivore fish (z-scored; coral predictor)
cov_mat <- rs(post$b_Corallivore_logcoral, coral_mat) + post$b_Corallivore_Intercept

# 6. Herbivore fish (z-scored; fleshy algae predictor)
herb_mat <- rs(post$b_herbs_logfleshy, fleshy_mat) + post$b_herbs_Intercept

# 7. Ecosystem Pmax (log-standardised; rd + coral + temp, all via bsp/b)
pmax_mat <- rs(post$bsp_logpmax_milogrd,      rd_mat)    +
            rs(post$b_logpmax_logcoral,        coral_mat) +
            rs(post$bsp_logpmax_mitemperature, temp_mat)  +
            post$b_logpmax_Intercept

# 8. Algal N content (log-standardised; rd via bsp imputed)
n_mat <- rs(post$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat) + post$b_Npercent_Intercept

# ── Back-transform to original units ─────────────────────────────────────────
bt_log <- function(mat, mu, sig) exp(mat * sig + mu)
bt_lin <- function(mat, mu, sig) mat * sig + mu

proj_list <- list(
  Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
  `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
  Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
  `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
  Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
  # N_percent is log-transformed in semdata2; use explicit log-scale params
  `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat,
                          mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))
)

# Derive P:R ratio directly from back-transformed Pmax and Rd matrices
proj_list[["P:R Ratio"]] <- proj_list$Pmax / proj_list$Respiration

# ── Summarise: posterior median + 50% + 95% CI per variable per year ─────────
proj_tbl <- imap_dfr(proj_list, function(mat, vname) {
  tibble(variable = vname,
         Year     = rep(proj_years, each = n),
         value    = as.vector(mat)) |>
    group_by(variable, Year) |>
    summarise(median = median(value),
              lo95   = quantile(value, 0.025), hi95 = quantile(value, 0.975),
              lo50   = quantile(value, 0.25),  hi50 = quantile(value, 0.75),
              .groups = "drop")
})

# ── Observed data for overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
obs_proj <- Year_Averages |>
  transmute(Year,
            Temperature    = Max_temp,
            `Coral Cover`  = mean_coral,
            Respiration    = Rd,
            `Fleshy Algae` = mean_fleshy,
            Pmax           = Pmax,
            `N Content`    = N_percent,
            `P:R Ratio`    = Pmax / Rd) |>
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "observed")

# ── Panel specs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
panel_spec <- tribble(
  ~variable,      ~panel, ~ylab,                                    ~col,       ~ylo,  ~yhi,
  "Temperature",  "A",    "Max. temperature (°C)",                  "#E65100",  28.5,  32.5,
  "Coral Cover",  "B",    "Coral cover (%)",                        "#2E7D32",   0,    25,
  "Respiration",  "C",    "Ecosystem Rd\n(mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹)",     "#4527A0",   0,    80,
  "Fleshy Algae", "D",    "Fleshy macroalgae (%)",                  "#827717",   0,    80,
  "Pmax",         "E",    "Ecosystem Pmax\n(mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹)",   "#0D47A1",  60,   170,
  "N Content",    "F",    "Algal N content (%)",                    "#BF360C",   0.3,   1.0,
  "P:R Ratio",    "G",    "P:R ratio\n(Pmax / Rd)",                 "#00695C",   1.5,   7.0
)

make_proj_panel <- function(variable, panel, ylab, col, ylo, yhi) {
  dat <- proj_tbl   |> filter(variable == !!variable)
  raw <- obs_proj   |> filter(variable == !!variable)
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Year)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2025.5, xmax = 2056, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "grey92") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = col, alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo50, ymax = hi50), fill = col, alpha = 0.30) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), color = col, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = raw, aes(y = observed),
               shape = 21, size = 1.7, color = col, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2025.5, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.45) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2055, 10)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ylo, yhi)) +
    labs(y = ylab, x = NULL,
         title = paste0(panel, ". ", variable)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold", color = col),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8))
}

panels <- pmap(panel_spec, make_proj_panel)

wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste("Grey shading = forecast (post-2025)  ·",
                    "Inner ribbon = 50% CI  ·  Outer ribbon = 95% CI  ·",
                    "Points = observed annual values  ·",
                    "P:R ratio = Pmax / Rd (ratio of gross photosynthesis to respiration)"),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0.5))
  )
```

### Results: Linear-Trend Projections

Projections indicate continued, broad-front ecosystem degradation under current warming trends (Fig. @fig-predictions). Maximum annual sea surface temperature is projected to reach 30.3°C (95% CI 29.7–30.9) by 2035 and 30.8°C (29.9–31.8) by 2050, an increase of approximately +0.9°C above the 2025 model estimate of 29.9°C. Coral cover, currently estimated at 7.1% (4.4–10.8%), is projected to decline to 5.4% (2.4–9.8%) by 2035 and 3.5% (0.9–9.1%) by 2050 — representing a further 50% reduction from the already-depleted 2025 level. Credible intervals on coral cover widen considerably with projection distance, reflecting compounded uncertainty propagated through the Year → Temperature → Coral causal pathway.

Driven by projected coral decline, ecosystem respiration is projected to fall from 35.6 mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ (28.9–43.6) in 2025 to 29.9 (16.7–46.1) by 2050, though widening uncertainty means the direction of change after 2035 is less certain than the 2005–2025 observed decline. Fleshy macroalgae cover shows the widest credible intervals of any projected variable, expanding from 17.6% (10.4–32.1%) in 2025 to a posterior median of 39.6% by 2050 with very wide bounds (12.8–80%+), reflecting accumulated uncertainty along the multi-step coral → algae → herbivore chain. Maximum photosynthetic capacity (Pmax) shows comparatively stable projections — declining modestly from 115 (101–130) to 107 (75–141) mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ — consistent with the weaker and partially offset direct and indirect temperature effects on Pmax identified in the SEM. Algal tissue N content is projected to decline slowly from 0.65% (0.56–0.74%) in 2025 to 0.60% (0.42–0.75%) by 2050, tracking declining respiration through the Rd → N pathway. The ecosystem P:R ratio (Pmax / Rd), which rose sharply from 2.3 (2005) to 4.0 (2025) as respiration collapsed faster than photosynthetic capacity, is projected to stabilise around 3.5 post-2025 with widening credible intervals (2.7–5.3 by 2050), reflecting compounded uncertainty from both Pmax and Rd trajectories.

### Interpretation: Linear-Trend Projections

Three features of the projections warrant particular ecological attention. First, the divergence between coral cover and Pmax trajectories is notable: coral continues to decline steeply while Pmax remains relatively stable, suggesting that photosynthetic capacity is increasingly decoupled from live coral structure — potentially reflecting expanding macroalgal and turf contributions to gross photosynthesis. Second, the very wide credible intervals on fleshy macroalgae beyond 2035 highlight that the macroalgal trajectory is the most uncertain element of the forecast; the log-normal model does not impose a ceiling on algal expansion, and actual dynamics may be constrained by herbivory, nutrient limitation, or disturbance. Third, the ecosystem P:R ratio (Pmax / Rd) rose sharply from a posterior median of 2.3 in 2005 to 4.0 in 2025 as ecosystem respiration collapsed far more rapidly than photosynthetic capacity — a trajectory from heterotrophy-dominated to autotrophy-dominated metabolism consistent with reef degradation. Post-2025, both Pmax and Rd are projected to stabilise at reduced levels; the P:R ratio is accordingly projected to remain elevated (~3.5) but shows widening uncertainty, reflecting the compounding of Pmax and Rd uncertainties. The observed P:R range over 2005–2025 (1.8–4.1) confirms that the regime shift in metabolic balance occurred largely within the observational record. Taken together, the projections suggest that without intervention, MCR Site 1 backreef will be characterised by sub-4% coral cover, elevated macroalgae, depressed respiration, and weakened internal nutrient cycling by mid-century.

## Reduced SEM: Parsimonious Model

Three of the twelve pathways in the full SEM had 95% credible intervals spanning zero — direct temperature effects on respiration (β = 0.22, 95% CI −0.22 to 0.62), direct temperature effects on Pmax (β = −0.16, −0.78 to 0.45), and a direct coral effect on Pmax (β = −0.35, −1.40 to 0.71) — indicating that these pathways are not reliably supported by the data. Retaining them in projection creates two problems: the positive temperature→Rd coefficient generates a spurious upward push on Rd when temperature is extrapolated beyond the fitted range, and the large uncertainty on the coral→Pmax and temperature→Pmax terms inflates Pmax credible intervals. A reduced 9-pathway SEM was therefore fitted with these three terms removed.

```{r sem-reduced-fit}
#| label: sem-reduced-model
#| cache: true

# Reduced SEM: remove 3 non-significant pathways
#   1. Temperature → Rd (direct):      remove mi(temperature) from bf_logrd
#   2. Temperature → Pmax (direct):    remove mi(temperature) from bf_logpmax
#   3. Coral → Pmax (direct):          remove logcoral from bf_logpmax

bf_temp_r        <- bf(temperature | mi()             ~ 1 + Year)
bf_coraltemp_r   <- bf(logcoral    | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ 1 + temperature + yearresid)
bf_logrd_r       <- bf(logrd       | mi()             ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_logpmax_r     <- bf(logpmax     | mi()             ~ 1 + mi(logrd))
bf_fleshy_r      <- bf(logfleshy   | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ logcoral)
bf_herbs_r       <- bf(herbs       | mi()             ~ 1 + logfleshy)
bf_corallivore_r <- bf(Corallivore | mi()             ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_nutrients_r   <- bf(Npercent    | mi()             ~ 1 + mi(logrd))

brms_sem_reduced <- brm(
  bf_temp_r + bf_coraltemp_r + bf_logrd_r + bf_herbs_r + bf_corallivore_r +
    bf_nutrients_r + bf_fleshy_r + bf_logpmax_r + set_rescor(FALSE),
  data    = semdata2,
  chains  = 3, iter = 10000, warmup = 5000, seed = 11,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior   = c(
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)",    class = "b"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", resp = "temperature", class = "sigma", lb = 0),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)",    class = "Intercept")
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  family  = gaussian(),
  silent = 2, refresh = 0
)
```

```{r sem-reduced-summary}
#| label: sem-reduced-results

summary(brms_sem_reduced)
```

```{r sem-reduced-r2}
#| label: sem-reduced-r2

# Manual R² for mi()-imputed responses
for (resp in c("logrd", "logpmax")) {
  fit_f <- fitted(brms_sem_full,    resp = resp)[, "Estimate"]
  fit_r <- fitted(brms_sem_reduced, resp = resp)[, "Estimate"]
  obs_v <- semdata2[[resp]]
  ok    <- !is.na(obs_v)
  cat(sprintf("%-10s  Full R²: %.3f   Reduced R²: %.3f\n", resp,
              cor(fit_f[ok], obs_v[ok])^2, cor(fit_r[ok], obs_v[ok])^2))
}
```

```{r sem-reduced-projections}
#| label: reduced-sem-projection-data

set.seed(6214)
post_r <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_reduced) |> as_tibble() |> slice_sample(n = 3000)
n_r    <- nrow(post_r)

# yearresid matrix: observed for 2005-2025, zero for 2026-2055
yr_resid_vec_r <- sapply(proj_years, function(y) {
  row <- yr_resid_lookup |> filter(Year == y)
  if (nrow(row) == 1 && !is.na(row$yr)) row$yr else 0
})
yr_resid_mat_r <- matrix(rep(yr_resid_vec_r, each = n_r), nrow = n_r)
yr_mat_r       <- matrix(rep(year_std, each = n_r), nrow = n_r)

# ── Propagate reduced SEM causal chain ────────────────────────────────────────
temp_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$b_temperature_Year,     yr_mat_r)   + post_r$b_temperature_Intercept
coral_mat_r  <- rs(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat_r) +
                rs(post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat_r) +
                post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept
rd_mat_r     <- rs(post_r$b_logrd_logcoral, coral_mat_r)      + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
fleshy_mat_r <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat_r) + post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                     z_ceil_fleshy)
cov_mat_r    <- rs(post_r$b_Corallivore_logcoral, coral_mat_r)+ post_r$b_Corallivore_Intercept
herb_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$b_herbs_logfleshy, fleshy_mat_r)    + post_r$b_herbs_Intercept
pmax_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd, rd_mat_r)      + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
n_mat_r      <- rs(post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat_r)     + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

proj_list_r <- list(
  Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat_r,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
  `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat_r,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
  Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat_r,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
  `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat_r, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
  Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat_r,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
  `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat_r,
                          mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))
)
proj_list_r[["P:R Ratio"]] <- proj_list_r$Pmax / proj_list_r$Respiration

proj_tbl_r <- imap_dfr(proj_list_r, function(mat, vname) {
  tibble(variable = vname, Year = rep(proj_years, each = n_r), value = as.vector(mat)) |>
    group_by(variable, Year) |>
    summarise(median = median(value),
              lo95 = quantile(value, .025), hi95 = quantile(value, .975),
              lo50 = quantile(value, .25),  hi50 = quantile(value, .75),
              .groups = "drop")
})

# ── Counterfactual: temperature stabilised at 2025 ────────────────────────────
temp_mat_r_cf <- temp_mat_r
temp_mat_r_cf[, which(proj_years > 2025)] <- temp_2025_std

coral_mat_r_cf  <- rs(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat_r_cf)   +
                   rs(post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat_r)  +
                   post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept
rd_mat_r_cf     <- rs(post_r$b_logrd_logcoral, coral_mat_r_cf)        + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
fleshy_mat_r_cf <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat_r_cf) + post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                        z_ceil_fleshy)
pmax_mat_r_cf   <- rs(post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd, rd_mat_r_cf)        + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
n_mat_r_cf      <- rs(post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat_r_cf)       + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

proj_tbl_r_cf <- imap_dfr(
  list(Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat_r_cf,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
       `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat_r_cf,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
       Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat_r_cf,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
       `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat_r_cf, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
       Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat_r_cf,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
       `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat_r_cf,
                               mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                               sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))),
  function(mat, vname) {
    tibble(variable = vname, Year = rep(proj_years, each = n_r), value = as.vector(mat)) |>
      group_by(variable, Year) |>
      summarise(median = median(value),
                lo95 = quantile(value, .025), hi95 = quantile(value, .975),
                lo50 = quantile(value, .25),  hi50 = quantile(value, .75),
                .groups = "drop")
  })

```

```{r fig-reduced-projections}
#| label: fig-reduced-proj
#| fig-cap: "**Reduced SEM projections (9 pathways), 2005–2055.** Three non-significant pathways from the full SEM were removed: direct temperature effects on ecosystem respiration (β = 0.22, 95% CI −0.22–0.62), direct temperature effects on Pmax (β = −0.16, −0.78–0.45), and direct coral effects on Pmax (β = −0.35, −1.40–0.71). Solid lines and ribbons show reduced SEM posterior median with 50% (inner) and 95% (outer) credible intervals. Dashed lines show the full SEM posterior median for comparison. Open points are annual observed values. Grey shading = forecast period (post-2025). The transient increase in Rd and N content at 2026–2035 reflects the yearresid = 0 forecast assumption: in 2025, the observed non-thermal decline (yearresid) was strongly suppressing coral below its temperature-driven expectation; releasing this suppression in the forecast temporarily allows partial coral and Rd recovery before continued temperature-driven decline resumes."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 11

# Observed data with P:R
obs_proj_r <- Year_Averages |>
  transmute(Year, Temperature = Max_temp, `Coral Cover` = mean_coral,
            Respiration = Rd, `Fleshy Algae` = mean_fleshy, Pmax = Pmax,
            `N Content` = N_percent, `P:R Ratio` = Pmax / Rd) |>
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "observed")

# Full SEM with P:R for overlay
proj_tbl_full_pr <- bind_rows(
  proj_tbl,
  proj_tbl |> filter(variable == "Pmax") |>
    left_join(proj_tbl |> filter(variable == "Respiration") |> select(Year, rd_med = median), by = "Year") |>
    mutate(variable = "P:R Ratio", across(c(median,lo95,hi95,lo50,hi50), ~ .x / rd_med)) |>
    select(-rd_med)
)

panel_spec_r <- tribble(
  ~variable,      ~panel, ~ylab,                                    ~col,       ~ylo,  ~yhi,
  "Temperature",  "A",    "Max. temperature (°C)",                  "#E65100",  28.5,  32.5,
  "Coral Cover",  "B",    "Coral cover (%)",                        "#2E7D32",   0,    25,
  "Respiration",  "C",    "Ecosystem Rd\n(mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹)",     "#4527A0",   0,    80,
  "Fleshy Algae", "D",    "Fleshy macroalgae (%)",                  "#827717",   0,    80,
  "Pmax",         "E",    "Ecosystem Pmax\n(mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹)",   "#0D47A1",  60,   170,
  "N Content",    "F",    "Algal N content (%)",                    "#BF360C",   0.3,   1.0,
  "P:R Ratio",    "G",    "P:R ratio (Pmax / Rd)",                  "#00695C",   1.5,   7.0
)

make_reduced_panel <- function(variable, panel, ylab, col, ylo, yhi) {
  dat_r    <- proj_tbl_r         |> filter(variable == !!variable)
  dat_full <- proj_tbl_full_pr   |> filter(variable == !!variable)
  raw      <- obs_proj_r         |> filter(variable == !!variable)
  
  ggplot(dat_r, aes(x = Year)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2025.5, xmax = 2056, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = col, alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo50, ymax = hi50), fill = col, alpha = 0.30) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), color = col, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(data = dat_full, aes(y = median),
              color = col, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_point(data = raw, aes(y = observed),
               shape = 21, size = 1.7, color = col, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2025.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.45) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2055, 10)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ylo, yhi)) +
    labs(y = ylab, x = NULL, title = paste0(panel, ". ", variable)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold", color = col),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8))
}

panels_r <- pmap(panel_spec_r, make_reduced_panel)

wrap_plots(panels_r, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste("Solid = reduced SEM (9 pathways)  ·  Dashed = full SEM (12 pathways)",
                    "·  Inner ribbon = 50% CI  ·  Outer = 95% CI  ·  Points = observed"),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0.5))
  )
```

The reduced model retains essentially the same R² for temperature (0.214 vs. 0.216), coral (0.713), and fleshy algae (0.817 vs. 0.816), with modest reductions for respiration (0.620 vs. 0.659) and Pmax (0.375 vs. 0.400) — the expected cost of removing three predictors. All nine retained pathway coefficients are stable relative to the full model (within 0.02 SD of each other; see Supplementary Table 1). The `Rd → Pmax` pathway tightens substantially (β = 0.61, 95% CI 0.19–1.05 vs. 0.81, 0.04–1.63 in the full model), because the competing temperature and coral terms were absorbing residual Pmax variance and inflating uncertainty.

In the reduced model projections, ecosystem respiration declines from 26.5 mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ in 2025 to 27.1 (16.7–36.3) by 2050 — a modest net decline compared to the full model's flat or slightly increasing trajectory (30.0 mmol). A transient rebound in Rd is apparent in 2026–2035 (Fig. @fig-reduced-proj, panel C), driven by the yearresid mechanism: in 2025, the observed non-thermal secular decline (yearresid = +1.57 SD) was strongly suppressing coral below its temperature-expected level; setting yearresid = 0 in the forecast releases this suppression and allows a partial coral and Rd recovery before rising temperatures resume the downward trend by the mid-2030s. This transient is a forecast assumption artefact rather than an ecological prediction — if the non-thermal decline drivers persist beyond 2025, coral and Rd would not rebound. Pmax credible intervals narrow meaningfully (95% CI 82–119 vs. 74–137 mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹), reflecting better-constrained downstream propagation.
